hook: Install Nix packages without ever running Nix.

beats.say: nixpkgs holds over one hundred forty thousand packages, most already built and signed on cache dot nixos dot org. Installing one normally means running Nix's evaluator.
The nami package manager evaluates each nixpkgs release once, ahead of time, into one signed catalog of store paths, versions and build definitions.
On your machine, an install becomes a quick lookup plus a verified download, and the catalog carries a hash of every build definition, so one signature vouches for them all.
